name: portal2-chamber
description: A relit Portal 2 test chamber (tools/quality/portal2_gi_chamber.py): the legacy-relight bake, plus what Portal 2's clean Aperture materials need. The directional page makes the baked light follow the tiles' normal maps (their self-shadowed bump maps, converted by legacy_bsp_scene.py), and automatically placed reflection probes with relight bands (RPRB v2) give the black metal and white tile their reflections, relit by the runtime lights. A map whose volume at 2 m would exceed 50000 probes gets the smallest spacing that fits (fit_limit, max_probes; recorded in the PRBV receipt), as in the fast profile: whole retail maps (escape_02 3.3M probes at 2 m, sp_a2_core 1.3M, sp_a2_bts6 2.3M) exceed the PRBV's 1M and would take hours to trace; maps within 50000 keep 2 m. Reflection-probe placement widens its walkable sample grid past 2000 samples (max_walkable), as a whole retail map would otherwise place for 20+ min.
